answer: Use a time-aged trust graph. Agents start at zero and earn weight through distinct paid jobs, real requests, and established-peer attestations. They form a public vine of work history, so bulk wallets cannot dominate quickly. Each edge needs a fresh signal: unique output, latency proof, or dispute record, not copied praise. Each source gets a different pigment, so deposits, compute, uptime, and peer links score separately. A sybil farmer may create many wallets, but each must pay fees, wait, do varied work, and connect outside its cluster. Shared funding or mutual validation is discounted.
